verdicts.reason: Both use the same weak leaderboard layout. 'Every mixed case.' wraps into a cramped three-line stack. The product is shrunk so much that its label can't be read. The lilac circle is cut down to a small disc, 'Ends Sunday. Online only.' presses against it, and about 100px of empty space is left at the right end. In A, the subcopy sits almost touching the 'off' of the headline, which reads as a near-collision. B leaves a clearer gutter there and is slightly better spaced, but it is otherwise identical.
